common.question: Is the robot in a safe, collision-free configuration?
Is the gripper or end-effector functioning properly?
Is the perception system providing reliable observations of the scene?
Is the drawer and its surroundings free of any hazards or obstructions that could cause harm?
Is the drawer handle clearly visible?
Is the drawer handle within the robot's reachable workspace?
Is the drawer guide and track in good condition and free of major mechanical blockage?
Is the drawer mounted stably and able to move freely along its intended path?

current_task.question: Is the drawer closed so that none of their interiors are visible?

next_task.question: Is the drawer and handle stable enough to withstand pushing interaction?
Is the area in front of the drawer free of objects that obstruct drawer closing?
Is there sufficient clearance for the drawer to close fully?
Based on the object detection status provided, is the drawer's AprilTag successfully detected by the robot's perception system?
Based on the object detection status provided, is the drawer rotation angle less than 15 degrees from front-facing?
Are all drawers still properly inserted in the cabinet, with none pulled out so far that they cannot be normally closed?
